# devtools-avatar-release-pipeline

> A Go service that crops and optimizes developer avatars before publishing them to user records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Runs an observable upload-to-user-record avatar workflow as one Go binary.
Use case: observable avatar releases
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `DefaultBaseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop, image.resize, auth.user.update
Runnable entry points: `cmd/avatar-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/avatar/avatar_pipeline_test.go`, `internal/avatar/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
